definition_of_done: A signed Android APK, installed and playable offline on a 2GB entry-level phone, with a complete run loop, garage upgrades and persistent save.

features.desc: Deterministic run simulation: road generation, motion, collisions
features.evidence: tools/run_sim_tests.sh - 20/20 checks, 6592 generated rows audited across 40 seeds

features.desc: Every row survivable: open lane exists and is reachable, no cheap spawns
Fares, combo payouts, upgrade cost curve, wallet
Profile serialisation, forward compatible, daily bonus
features.evidence: profile round-trip and corrupt-input checks green

features.desc: Unity scene renders the sim: road, kombi, entities, camera
One-thumb steering: drag and tap-half, plus keyboard in editor
HUD: distance, fuel, hull, riders, cash, combo
Menu, garage upgrades, game over with run summary
Save/load to persistentDataPath, survives app restart
Sprite set: kombi, road, potholes, traffic, roadblock, passenger, coin, fuel
Engine loop plus SFX for hit, pickup, payout
Editor build script produces an installable APK
GitHub Actions runs sim tests on every push and builds the APK on demand
60fps and under 60MB APK on an entry-level device
